enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing steadily. Turns over. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep. At 06:30, opens eyes. Sits up. Stretches arms. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl, plate, pan. Close cupboard. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Set table. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Finish eating. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Put dishes away. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Put on uniform. Check schedule. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Visit patient room. Check patient's vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Consult with doctor. Update patient records. Use computer. Make phone calls. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Visit more patients. Complete paperwork. End shift.
Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pot, pan, plate. Close cupboard. Turn on stove. Cook dinner. Set table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Put dishes away. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Browse internet. Close laptop. Watch TV. Get up. Go to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Turn off light. Exit living room.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Adjust pillow. Turn over. Remain asleep.
